evidence_units.claim: NEW YORK, 2026-02-04T07:01:38-05:00 – The NEW YORK TIMES CO Company (NYSE:NYT) announced today fourth -quarter and full-year 2025 results.
evidence_units.source_quote: NEW YORK, 2026-02-04T07:01:38-05:00 – The NEW YORK TIMES CO Company (NYSE:NYT) announced today fourth -quarter and full-year 2025 results.

evidence_units.claim: • The Company added approximately 450,000 net digital-only subscribers compared with the end of the third quarter of 2025, bringing the total number of subscribers to 12.78 million.
evidence_units.source_quote: • The Company added approximately 450,000 net digital-only subscribers compared with the end of the third quarter of 2025, bringing the total number of subscribers to 12.78 million.

evidence_units.claim: • Total digital-only average revenue per user (“ARPU”) increased 0.7 percent year-over-year to $9.72 largely driven by subscribers transitioning from promotional to higher prices and price increases on certain tenured subscribers.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Total digital-only average revenue per user (“ARPU”) increased 0.7 percent year-over-year to $9.72 largely driven by subscribers transitioning from promotional to higher prices and price increases on certain tenured subscribers.

evidence_units.claim: • Growth in both digital subscribers and ARPU drove a year-over-year increase in digital subscription revenues of 13.9 percent.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Growth in both digital subscribers and ARPU drove a year-over-year increase in digital subscription revenues of 13.9 percent.

evidence_units.claim: • Digital advertising revenues increased 24.9 percent year-over-year primarily due to strong marketer demand and new advertising supply.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Digital advertising revenues increased 24.9 percent year-over-year primarily due to strong marketer demand and new advertising supply.

evidence_units.claim: • Affiliate, licensing and other revenues increased 5.5 percent year-over-year as a result of higher licensing revenues.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Affiliate, licensing and other revenues increased 5.5 percent year-over-year as a result of higher licensing revenues.

evidence_units.claim: • Operating costs increased 10.5 percent year-over-year and adjusted operating costs (defined below) increased 9.7 percent year-over-year, largely as a result of higher cost of revenue, general and administrative costs, sales and marketing and product development costs.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Operating costs increased 10.5 percent year-over-year and adjusted operating costs (defined below) increased 9.7 percent year-over-year, largely as a result of higher cost of revenue, general and administrative costs, sales and marketing and product development costs.

evidence_units.claim: • Operating profit increased 10.2 percent year-over-year to $161.6 million, while adjusted operating profit (defined below) increased 12.8 percent year-over-year to $192.3 million.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Operating profit increased 10.2 percent year-over-year to $161.6 million, while adjusted operating profit (defined below) increased 12.8 percent year-over-year to $192.3 million.

evidence_units.claim: • Operating profit margin for the quarter was 20.1 percent, a year-over-year decrease of approximately 10 basis points and adjusted operating profit margin (defined below) was 24.0 percent, a year-over-year increase of approximately 50 basis points.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Operating profit margin for the quarter was 20.1 percent, a year-over-year decrease of approximately 10 basis points and adjusted operating profit margin (defined below) was 24.0 percent, a year-over-year increase of approximately 50 basis points.

evidence_units.claim: • Diluted earnings per share for the quarter was $.79, a $.04 increase year-over-year and adjusted diluted earnings per share (defined below) was $.89, a $.09 increase year-over-year.
evidence_units.source_quote: • Diluted earnings per share for the quarter was $.79, a $.04 increase year-over-year and adjusted diluted earnings per share (defined below) was $.89, a $.09 increase year-over-year.
